closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, fibre, and magnesium, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low calcium, and low omega 3. It is good for heart health, digestion, and energy and endurance sports because fibre supports the heart-health side, fibre supports digestion and steadier meals, and the carb section gives usable fuel.
